sourceQuote: must have held the valid foreign passport or certificates of nationality for at least four years, and over two years(nine-month actual residence in foreign countries within one year can be caltulated as one year,subject to the entry and exit date) of the actural foreign residence record within the last four years
targetQuote: 必须至少连续四年持有有效外国护照或国籍证明，并且在最近四年内具有两年以上实际境外居留记录（一年内九个月的实际境外居留可按一年计算，以入境和出境日期为准）
